intent: An incident stops every user-started model call, and a halted queue neither burns its waiting runs nor feeds batches.
observable_outcome: get-context run, batch, creation, ingest and testlab list the new rules as reviewed, proven by their tests.

acceptance_criteria.statement: While a P1 incident halts dispatch, generating a skill, a creation step and a criteria suggestion are refused before the model is called and nothing is charged; a creation step that was refused is not counted and the session waits for the person to send again. An unreadable halt state counts as halted.

A run waiting for a sandbox slot times out only after the slot-wait limit plus every stretch during which dispatch was paused for every provider that could take it; if the halt history cannot be read the run keeps waiting.

While dispatch is paused for every provider, by an orphan threshold or a P1 incident, an evaluation batch waits instead of creating its next trial, and starts it on the first advance after the halt lifts.
A run no provider has accepted waits for a slot up to the slot-wait limit plus the time dispatch was paused for it, and is timed out with a queue reason just past that.
